CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Shared conventions

The portfolio’s shared rules are synced into .claude/shared/ from pedrobtz/packages:claude/shared/. Never edit them here. Where this file and a shared file disagree, this file wins for this package.

@.claude/shared/workflow.md @.claude/shared/r-package.md @.claude/shared/ci.md @.claude/shared/native-code.md

What this is

zugeo makes GeoArrow a first-class column type in R. It registers every geoarrow.* extension name with zuarrow, keeps geometries in Arrow memory as a geo_vctr, computes bounds, Hilbert keys and spatial sorts over the coordinate buffers, builds flatbush- and kdbush-format packed indexes, and, with qio 0.2.0, reads and writes GeoParquet. Every conversion is exact or an error; a CRS is carried, never resolved or invented. Imports are zuarrow and zujson only. No package outside the family appears in DESCRIPTION: sf, wk, geos, s2, geoarrow, nanoarrow, arrow and duckdb are CI-only oracles. No system library. It is not a geometry engine, not a projection library and not an sf replacement; WKB and a CRS string are the bridge to those.

The specification is .agents/design.md, adopted from RFC 0071. It outranks this file.

Current state

Scaffolded 2026-11-05 with create-pkg.sh (C, through use_c()); no functionality yet. The roadmap in .agents/roadmap.md takes it to v0.1.0.

Versions and dependents

The current version’s parent issue is the v0.1.0 issue, created by pkg-roadmap. Sibling packages that depend on this one before CRAN does: none yet. qio (GeoParquet), zuclip and zucdt are expected consumers (design §3).

Commands

None beyond the shared ones yet.

Architecture

To be written as stages land; see .agents/design.md §4. The scaffold has the C layer from use_c(): src/zugeo.c and @useDynLib zugeo, .registration = TRUE in R/zugeo-package.R.

Invariants that are easy to break

  • Nothing outside the family in DESCRIPTION, not even Suggests (design D3). Oracle tests live in tests/testthat/test-ci-*.R, which .Rbuildignore keeps out of the tarball.
  • No JSON code in src/ (D4). Extension metadata, the GeoParquet geo key and PROJJSON go through zujson.
  • The vendored nanoarrow core is namespaced as ZugeoNanoarrow (D2), and every symbol is hidden. An unnamespaced copy clashes with zuarrow’s copy or a loaded nanoarrow.
  • A CRS is never resolved, guessed or dropped (D6). Checks inside zugeo use geo_crs_equal(level = "identical") only (D14).
  • Subsetting and sorting a geo_vctr never copy buffers (D5).
  • Index bytes stay flatbush- and kdbush-compatible (D13).

Testing

The conformance corpus is geoarrow-data v0.2.0 (design §9), with geoarrow, arrow/pyarrow, DuckDB spatial, sf, geos, s2, wk, gpq, and flatbush/kdbush under node as oracles. None is wired up yet. No helpers yet.

Continuous integration

Calls the shared r-cmd-check.yml and coverage.yml from pedrobtz/r-actions@v1, and its own pkgdown.yaml. The design plans an oracles workflow (Stage 3) that runs the CI-only tests with ZUGEO_ORACLES=true. Stages 2, 6 and 9 are full.

Vendored native code

geoarrow-c and the nanoarrow core it builds on, both Apache-2.0, pinned in Stage 0 (design §7). Not vendored yet; fill in the version and local patches when it is.
